request: 最后是 code 0，那个 0 可以就是隐藏的红点，然后再变化到中间；策划
concept: 红核从一开始就藏在退出码 0 的字形内；其余文字退场后显露同一个核心，再连续移到中央，以开场的构图结束。
narrative: 观众先读到正常退出，随后发现代表希苒的红核仍在。

zeroAnchor.motion: almost horizontal leftward reframing, with a small downward component

timeline.action: 保留原退出文字的输入与短暂停留；0 正常可读，暗红核心藏在其内部，作为低对比细节。
其余文字、方括号和光标退下，0 留在原位置并变红；内部粒子逐渐显露，字形轮廓退下，形成同中心的小红核。
核心沿近乎水平的路径移到画面中央；移动后半程与镜头推近重叠，等比放大到开场匹配的红核尺寸，最后自然减速。
居中保持约 1.22 秒，仅有轻微内部流动与明暗呼吸，红核可见直到最后一帧。

motion.path: single short leftward translation to center
motion.camera: fixed direction forward approach overlapping the latter part of translation
motion.scale: uniform apparent growth by camera distance; constant spherical proportions

material.zero: existing terminal dot-matrix glyph with a latent low-luminance red center
material.reveal: latent core illuminates while the glyph outline loses emphasis; same center throughout
material.final: same centered red core as opening, on black background

scope: final terminal shot: reveal the hidden core in exit code 0, then reframe continuously

audio.timing: use existing near-silent tail; no added beat or duration extension
